description: Substrate-parameter anchor chain.  Records the current q_0 ≈ 1.10998 as a `script-cited` debt against `q_parameter.py` and pins the value via the AXIOM `def:substrate-parameter-planck`.  Trust profile {axiom: 1, script-cited: 1, computational: 1} — **not fully-trusted by design**: the SCRIPT_CITED frontier remains open until one of the three candidate derivations (α-FSC PSLQ closure, m_p/m_e tower inversion, brane-tower volume conjecture) lands as a real script.  Replaces PR #481's `q0-derivation-skeleton` (which referenced two scripts that were never written and one whose 2000 dps variant was never landed).

steps.name: Substrate parameter q_0 ∈ ℝ_{>1}
steps.operation: By `def:substrate-parameter-planck`, the QOU manuscript introduces a single real parameter `q_0 ∈ ℝ_{>1}` characterising the Hecke energy scale `(q − q^{-1})`.  Existence and uniqueness follow from the Planck-normalisation: `G(q_0) = 1` fixes `q_0` to be the unique positive solution of the gravitational-constant fixed-point equation.

steps.name: Numerical value of q_0 from Planck normalisation
steps.operation: Numerical solution of `G(q_0) = 1` (the Planck-normalised gravitational-constant fixed-point) at the canonical fit precision yields `q_0 ≈ 1.109978582751381`.  The compute-pipeline source of truth is the pinned literal `derivation_chain.Q_0`; the upstream computation that produced this literal lives in `q_parameter.py` (which derives `Q` from the figure-eight knot volume and the muon-electron mass ratio).  The pin is manually synchronised — when `q_parameter.Q` is regenerated at higher precision, `derivation_chain.Q_0` must be updated to match.
steps.notes: script: computations/substrate/q_parameter.py.  This SCRIPT_CITED step is the open frontier of the chain — the candidate derivations on the horizon are (A) closure of the α-FSC ↔ q_0 algebraic relation via `alpha_em_pslq_uniqueness.py` at higher precision, (B) inversion of the m_p/m_e mass-endomorphism tower, (C) a brane-tower topological invariant (e.g. a canonical-knot hyperbolic volume).  None has produced a closed form to date; this anchor remains the source of truth and every prediction inherits its precision.

steps.name: q_0 leaf evaluation
steps.operation: Bit-stable evaluation of the canonical `Q_0` literal from step 2.  Validator cross-check is exact equality.
